title: The Gysin map on a restricted class is the cup product of the pulled back class with the Gysin class of the unit

difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the Gysin image of a restricted class with the cup product of the pulled back class with the Gysin class of the unit (statement lines 5519-5526). The proof explains both sides of the formula, using functoriality for the restriction and for the Gysin maps, the cup product for local cohomology with support and the vanishing of the support cohomology above the codimension to descend to the degree $c$ sheaves, and then reduces the claim to the commutativity of one diagram, the local verification of which is left to the reader with the maps chosen to make it hold. The reduction through the support cup product is the substance, so the claim is H2.
